profile.headline: Mobile & Full-Stack Software Developer: iOS, Swift, C#, Xamarin, React Native | 17+ Years Building Commercial Apps | Open to Remote
profile.summary:
I've been building software professionally since I was 15. I completed my Computer Science degree at 18, and have spent the 17 years since shipping mobile and full-stack applications for commercial clients across retail, healthcare, restaurant, and finance.
My core strength is mobile development: native iOS and Android (Swift, Objective-C, Java), Xamarin Forms, and React Native, alongside full-stack work in C#/.NET, React, and Firebase. I'm comfortable owning a project end-to-end, and I have a track record of stepping into existing or half-finished codebases and carrying them to a shipped, working product.
I currently combine software development with IT systems administration and business operations for a two-location retail company, including building internal tools, managing POS systems and compliance reporting, and administering network infrastructure.
Open to new mobile and full-stack roles, remote or Tampa Bay area.

positions.title: Software Developer / IT Administrator
positions.description: Monitor and maintain network infrastructure across two retail locations, ensuring continuous uptime for point of sale and payment systems. Design and build internal business applications, including a gold and silver spot price calculator used by staff to price merchandise in real time, and a loan management system for tracking a high value client relationship. Build custom reporting tools in Excel, Google Sheets, and LibreCalc to turn Bravo POS data into actionable business reports. Create and manage rotating weekly staff schedules across both locations, balancing coverage with cross training. Design and execute recurring audits within Bravo POS, covering store health checks and inventory verification. Serve as primary liaison with the payment processor, resolving terminal outages and verifying transaction integrity during network disruptions.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · Point of Sale (POS) Systems · Network Administration · Microsoft Excel · DSM · Docker · Business Reporting

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Increasing degree of responsibility, technical process knowledge, and operational expertise over tenure with regional and national leaders spanning multiple industries

Subject matter expertise in Mobile Development, C#, testing, optimization, and utilizing advanced problem solving abilities in the rapid acquisition of new languages and platforms

Skilled in the development of prototypes for various mobile & web applications, troubleshooting & resolution of complex code complications across platforms, rewriting & building applications, warehouse management systems development, algorithm utilization, and the creation of innovative and functional user experiences 

Unique ability to effectively communicate and collaborate across departmental levels and engage internal and external stakeholders including project managers, co-workers, trainers and organizational leadership
